You: Damn it!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It seems like that’s as far as you go. Your sins weigh too heavy on you. There’s no shame in admitting that.
You: …
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Just come back to faith and-
You: If it means losing {f_botName} then I won’t!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Then suffer the consequences.
